passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people, except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother, or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Aaron’s sons are the priests.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the priests.
The LORD said, “A priest must not make himself unclean for a dead person among his people.
A priest may become unclean only for his closest relatives.
These relatives are his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, or his brother.
A priest may also become unclean for his unmarried sister who is close to him.
This sister must not have a husband.
A priest may become unclean for her.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־ יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃ כִּ֚י אִם־ לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃ וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃

passages.text: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.
passages.sermon: A priest must not make himself unclean for relatives by marriage.\r\nHe must not do this among his people.\r\nIf he does, he will profane himself.

passages.text: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
passages.sermon:
Priests serve God.
Priests must not make bald spots on their heads.
Priests must not shave off the edges of their beards.
Priests must not make cuts in their bodies.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יִקְרְחָה קָרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃

passages.text: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.
passages.sermon:
Priests serve God.
Priests must be holy to their God.
Priests must not profane the name of their God.
Priests present offerings made by fire to the LORD.
These offerings are the food of their God.
Because priests present these offerings, they must be holy.
passages.original: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־ אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
passages.sermon:
A priest serves God.
A priest is holy to his God.
A priest must not marry a woman who has been defiled by prostitution.
A priest must not marry a woman who is divorced from her husband.
God requires the priest to remain holy.
passages.original: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy—I who set you apart.
passages.sermon:
The priest presents the food of your God.
You must regard the priest as holy.
He must be holy to you.
I am the LORD.
I am holy.
I set you apart.
passages.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ אֶת־ לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.
passages.sermon:
A priest is a man set apart for God.
A priest is holy to God.
A priest’s daughter must not defile herself.
If a priest’s daughter becomes a prostitute, she brings shame to her father.
She dishonors her father.
She must be burned with fire.
passages.original: וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ס

passages.text: The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.
passages.sermon:
The high priest is the most important priest among his brothers.
People pour anointing oil on his head.
He is ordained to wear the special priestly garments.
He must not let his hair hang loose.
He must not tear his garments.
passages.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יוּצַ֥ק עַל־ רֹאשׁ֣וֹ׀ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־ הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־ רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃

passages.text: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.
passages.sermon:
The high priest must not go near any dead body.
He must not make himself unclean for anyone who has died.
He must not do this even for his father.
He must not do this even for his mother.
passages.original: וְעַ֛ל כָּל־ נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃

passages.text: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The high priest is the leader among his brothers.
God has chosen the high priest.
God has poured anointing oil on the high priest’s head.
God has set the high priest apart for holy service.
The high priest must not leave the sanctuary of his God.
The high priest must not desecrate the sanctuary of his God.
God’s anointing oil marks the high priest as holy.
I am the LORD.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The woman he marries must be a virgin.
passages.sermon:
The priest must marry a woman.
The woman must be a virgin.
The priest must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution.
The priest must marry a virgin from his own people.
The priest must do this to keep his offspring holy among his people.
The LORD sanctifies the priest.

passages.text: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people, so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.”
passages.sermon:
The high priest must not marry a widow.
He must not marry a divorced woman.
He must not marry a woman who is defiled by prostitution.
He must not marry any of these women.
He must marry a virgin.
She must be from his own people.
He must do this so he does not defile his children among his people.
I am the LORD.
I make him holy.
passages.original: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־ אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־ בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃ וְלֹֽא־ יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The LORD said, “Tell Aaron this message.
This message is for Aaron and his descendants.
This rule applies to all future generations.
No man from Aaron’s descendants who has a physical defect may approach God’s altar.
A man with a defect must not offer the food of his God.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: No man who has any defect may approach—no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed; no man who has a broken foot or hand, or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to Moses for Aaron and his descendants.
God spoke about the priests of Israel.
No man with a physical defect may approach to offer sacrifices to God.
A man who is blind may not approach.
A man who is lame may not approach.
A man who is disfigured may not approach.
A man who is deformed may not approach.
A man with a broken foot may not approach.
A man with a broken hand may not approach.
A man who is a hunchback may not approach.
A man who is a dwarf may not approach.
A man with a defect in his eye may not approach.
A man with a festering rash may not approach.
A man with scabs may not approach.
A man with a crushed testicle may not approach.
passages.original: כִּ֥י כָל־ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃ אֽוֹ־ גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־ דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּעֵינ֑וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃

passages.text: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron had descendants who served as priests after him.
A priest must not have a physical defect.
If a descendant of Aaron has a defect, he cannot approach the altar.
He must not present the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
He has a defect.
He must not come near to offer the food of his God.
passages.original: כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃

passages.text: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food, but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A man from the descendants of Aaron may have a physical defect.
This man may eat the most holy food of his God.
He may also eat the holy food.
But he must not go near the veil.
He must not approach the altar.
He has a defect.
He must not desecrate My sanctuaries.
I am the LORD.
I sanctify them.
passages.original: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּמִן־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל׃ אַ֣ךְ אֶל־ הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־ מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to Aaron.\r\nMoses spoke to Aaron’s sons.\r\nMoses spoke to all the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
